Noah (AE): quick thread to finalize POC sandbox handoff: hosting tier, redaction owner, and success criteria. Need sign-off by EOD Fri. @Jade (SE) @Rory (Solutions) @Kei (Customer IT)
Jade (SE): two choices: Hosted test project (fastest) with our ingest redactor, or Dedicated short pilot (isolated infra). Which can you accept?
Kei (Customer IT): Dedicated preferred due to policy. We'll provide ~2k rows + 100 labeled eval items. Must pseudonymize name/email; cannot share raw account_ids.
Rory (Solutions): we can accept pre-redacted files or run our redaction during ingest and emit a redaction report (field-level hashes + counts). For Dedicated we can restrict egress and meet your retention needs.
Mira (Customer ML): eval targets: 150 blind prompts + 50 labeled. Quality target: >=88% accuracy on intent+action extraction. Latency target: p95 <300ms.
Noah (AE): note on pricing: hosted POC covered by credits; Dedicated pilot needs a refundable hold equal to one week capacity. I'll send exact numbers.
Kei (Customer IT): transfer: we'll use presigned S3 PUTs to s3://quasar-poc/uploads/. Need an example policy and IP ranges.
Rory (Solutions): sample policy snippet and presigned curl example we'll DM. Egress CIDRs (test): 18.205.0.0/16, 35.208.0.0/16 (we'll confirm exact list in SLA).
Jade (SE): proposed success criteria: 1) 200 end-to-end generations; 2) quality >=88% on labeled set; 3) p95 latency <300ms; 4) redaction report approved by privacy lead; 5) logs retention max 7 days and exportable. Agree?
Kei (Customer IT): agree to 1-3 and 5. For 4 we require SLA signed before any upload.
Noah (AE): we'll send the redaction SLA and security questionnaire to security@quasar.com. Security-bot will schedule a 30m call.
security-bot: scheduled security scoping call with Customer IT for Thu 14:00 UTC. Invite sent.
Rory (Solutions): timeline (BD): Day0 kickoff+creds; Day1 SLA + data prep; Day2 ingest+redaction smoke; Day3 routing+smoke; Day4 eval run; Day5 wrap & sign-off. Target ~5 BD.
Mira (Customer ML): I'll share the prompt set and a simple Python harness to run locally. Example prompt: "Summarize ticket and propose 3 next steps." Keep it short.
Noah (AE): next steps: I'll send refundable hold info; Rory to share ingest checklist and policy; Jade to drop eval harness. Target provisioning by next Tue. :thumbsup:
